title: KAITO — A Curious Rascal〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, can you put this chair back over there?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'll take that chair too, KAITO, so would you mind helping Ichi move the desks back?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, we're done...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! All that's left is to have you check our work, Luka, since you're on the cleanup committee♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, let me take a look.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You guys mentioned how Luka's on the cleanup committee.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, she checks over how good a job we've done of cleaning up after each practice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. And I'm sure she's very thorough.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Miku, MEIKO, which committees are you on...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm the class representative. Like you were, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And I'm a hall monitor.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! Those suit you both so well!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Actually, how did you all choose which committees you'd be on?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I was gonna ask the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: KAITO being a member of the animal caretaker committee does fit somehow, but I've been wondering how you ended up on it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: No reason in particular...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If I recall, Miku, Luka and MEIKO were the first to suggest this idea...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Committees...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. I just talked to Luka and MEIKO about doing something similar to Ichika and the girls.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It seems kind of appropriate since we're in a school. I think it'd be really fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
I'm all for it♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't mind as long as it doesn't involve a lot of extra work.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What about you, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't mind either way...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Then, let's do it.
I'm sure things will be fun once we get the ball rolling.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, what are our committee options?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We haven't decided yet, so just pick one you want.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As for me, I'd like to be a class representative.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'd like to be on the cleanup committee, and MEIKO wants to be a hall monitor.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ichika used to be a class representative, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And Hona's on the cleanup committee♪ But I don't think any of them were ever hall monitors...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Doesn't that involve making sure all the students follow the rules and adhere to the dress code...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. But this school doesn't really have any rules to speak of, so I was thinking about focusing on lifestyle things like making sure we all greet each other and don't run in the corridors.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, me next! Sakki was on the sports festival planning committee! Can I choose something like that...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course. Now that you mention it, we're going to need someone to come up with fun ideas and activities for us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... If we want her to cover a lot of different things, it might not be good to limit her to just the sports festival.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Good point!
Then... What if we called it the fun and games committee?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Straight to the point...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think that's a good thing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll come up with fun stuff for us to do each month! Starting with an event where we all chat while munching on snacks!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Maybe I should join you.
I'm kinda worried about letting you decide everything, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're just after the snacks, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
I mean, there's gotta be more fun things to do than just having snacks.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you'll both do a wonderful job.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That just leaves you, KAITO.
Are there really no committees that you'd like to be on?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not sure...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What's left? We've got the broadcasting committee, the library committee and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The animal caretaker committee. Shiho's a member.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, why don't you choose that?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What? But we don't have any rabbits here, do we...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I dunno, but you're always playing for little birds and stuff, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I think the animal caretaker committee suits you really well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. So that's how you ended up becoming a member.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They told me that I didn't have to do all that much, so I didn't mind agreeing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (And I got to meet Shibao because I'm a member...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure about this at first, but I might enjoy being on the animal caretaker committee if I keep getting to do those kinds of things...)
